parlays.note: Since 2026-10-25 ladder tickets are built separately with spread-out legs (before that they were nested, so one loss sank every larger ticket).

stats.note: Calibration factor applied to a probability bucket once it has 30+ graded legs.

note: 268 FanDuel-priced candidates (dc, dnb, ml, ml3, prop, spread, total) across 3 games; best single market per game kept (odds -1000 to +300); 3 not-yet-started games -> parlays up to 3 legs.

conditions.name: v2 higher avg CLV vs FanDuel
v2 higher avg CLV vs Pinnacle
At least 30 top picks graded (each model)

model_check.rule: v1 is live. v2 is only PROPOSED (switch_ready) when ALL hold on the same graded legs: 100+ graded legs, lower log loss, higher avg CLV vs FanDuel AND vs Pinnacle, 30+ top picks graded and a top-pick win rate (King's Favorite/Best Parlay legs + top leg per game) at least v1's. Even then the user is asked first; it never switches on its own.

sharp_filter.note: Report only: tested live on 2026-10-25, it swapped 16 of 36 game picks and lowered the average Pinnacle-rated win chance of the picks (86.7% -> 85.9%), because the safest alt lines carry the most FanDuel vig. Since the goal is win rate, it stays off.
sharp_filter.rule: Legs dropped when FanDuel's price implies a chance more than 3 pts above Pinnacle's no-vig fair chance (you'd be overpaying vs the sharp market).
